airlines.label: Official rule

cabin.summary: Cabin accepted for cats and small dogs in a soft-sided carrier under the seat. No snub-nosed breed ban stated for the cabin.

hold_cargo.summary: Short/snub-nosed (brachycephalic) dog breeds cannot travel in the baggage compartment. Named breed list not published on the pets page. Seasonal heat/cold and route embargoes also apply.

breed_list.summary: Air Canada names the category 'short/snub-nosed (brachycephalic) breeds' of dogs for the baggage compartment ban but does not list individual breed names on the official pets page.

airlines.conditions: Baggage: hard-sided kennel; summer heat limits (e.g. many U.S. cities May 1–Nov 30 when >29.5°C/85°F); winter cold limits; peak Dec 18–Jan 4 no pets as checked baggage/cargo. Soft-sided only in cabin (from June 1, 2025).
airlines.fetch_note: Official pets page fetched successfully. | Official pets page names the brachy category for dogs only; no individual breed names; cats not mentioned for this restriction.

airlines.label: Official rule

cabin.summary: Pets up to 8 kg (17.64 lb) including carrier may travel in the cabin. No snub-nosed breed ban stated on the official pet travel page.

hold_cargo.summary: Not stated on the official page for ordinary pets on the pet travel page.

breed_list.summary: Not stated on the official page on the general pet travel page.

airlines.conditions: Ordinary pets: hold booking ≤24 h before departure. Service dogs: see scoped note (hold ban for snub-nosed assistance dogs only).
airlines.fetch_note: Pet page: no general brachy ban. SVAN page: snub-nosed hold ban scoped to guide/assistance dogs.
gaps: Ordinary-pet snub-nosed hold rule still not stated on the general pet page

scope_notes.text: On the official Air France guide/assistance-dog page: if a guide/assistance dog is too large to meet cabin seating rules, it may travel free in the hold in a suitable kennel — except snub-nosed or flat-nosed dogs (chiens à nez retroussé ou plat), which cannot travel in the hold for medical reasons. Scope is guide/assistance dogs, not ordinary pets.

airlines.label: Official rule

cabin.summary: Short-nosed dogs and cats may travel in the cabin if the carrier fits under the seat (Alaska Air Cargo Pet Connect restrictions page).

hold_cargo.summary: Brachycephalic (short-nosed) dogs and cats and mixes are not accepted in the cargo compartment. Passenger pets page: baggage-compartment pets are subject to breed restrictions. Alaska Air Cargo notice: ban on AS/HA/QX cargo hold from Oct 1, 2026.

breed_list.summary: Dogs: Boston Terrier; Boxer (all); Bulldog (all); Brussels Griffon; Chow Chow; English Toy Spaniel; Japanese Spaniel/Japanese Chin; Mastiff (all); Pekingese; Pug (all); Shih Tzu. Cats: Burmese; Exotic Shorthair; Himalayan; Persian. Mixes containing these types included.

airlines.conditions: Cargo weather: often refused above 85°F (29.5°C) or below 45°F (7°C); cold exception with acclimation certificate (within 10 days). Baggage compartment also subject to travel-date embargoes and fleet restrictions. Cabin booking via chat/phone after passenger ticket.
airlines.fetch_note: Named list from Alaska Air Cargo Pet Connect restrictions (official). Passenger baggage SPA page body did not render breed names today. | Passenger 'pets in baggage compartment' SPA page did not return the named list in fetch; cargo list used for named breeds

airlines.label: Official rule

cabin.summary: Carry-on pets limited to cats and dogs that meet size/age/destination rules. No brachycephalic breed ban stated for carry-on pets.

hold_cargo.summary: Checked pets (military/State Dept only) and American Airlines Cargo (PetEmbark): brachycephalic / snub-nosed dogs and cats and mixes not accepted. PetEmbark also requires a vet-signed breed verification form.

breed_list.summary: Passenger checked pets + AA Cargo PetEmbark (aligned): Dogs — Affenpinscher; American Bully; American Staffordshire Terrier; Boston Terrier; Boxer (all); Brussels Griffon; Bulldog (all); Cane Corso; Chow Chow; Dogue De Bordeaux; English Toy Spaniel; Japanese Chin; Lhasa Apso; Mastiff (all); Pekingese; Pit Bull; Presa Canario; Pug (all); Shar Pei; Shih Tzu; Staffordshire Terrier; Tibetan Spaniel. Cats — Burmese; Exotic Shorthair; Himalayan; Persian. Mixes included.

airlines.conditions: Checked/passenger: heat >85°F / cold <45°F (acclimation letter 20–45°F); PHX/TUS/LAS/PSP May 1–Sep 30 non-cabin embargo. PetEmbark: ground temps 45–85°F; breed verification form required for all dogs/cats; no sedation.

airlines.label: Official rule

cabin.summary: BA does not carry pets in the cabin on any route (assistance dogs under separate rules).

hold_cargo.summary: Pets travel in the hold via partners. IAG Cargo (BA cargo arm): some snub-nosed breeds of cats and dogs may not be accepted — confirm with the pet travel agent. PetAir UK (BA partner from the UK) publishes guidance on flat-faced/BOAS travel but no named absolute ban list on the pages read today.

breed_list.summary: No named breed list on BA pets page or IAG Cargo Pets FAQ. IAG Cargo: snub-nosed breeds 'may not be accepted' (agent confirms). Container rule: snub-nosed dogs and cats need a kennel at least 10% larger than the minimum.

airlines.conditions: From UK: PetAir UK. To UK: IAG Cargo. IAG Cargo: snub-nosed pets require 10% larger container than minimum. Always confirm breed acceptance with the assigned pet travel agent before booking.
airlines.http_status: 200 BA + IAG Cargo Pets + PetAir UK blog
airlines.fetch_note: IAG Cargo Pets FAQ filled partner gap (may not accept snub-nosed; 10% larger crate). PetAir UK page is guidance/blog, not a named ban list.
gaps: No named snub-nosed breed list on BA or IAG Cargo Pets pages — acceptance case-by-case via pet travel agent

airlines.label: Official rule

cabin.summary: In-cabin pets: no brachycephalic breed ban on the Pet Travel Overview page.

hold_cargo.summary: Until further notice, Delta Cargo ships pets only for active U.S. Military / State Dept FSO with PCS orders. Brachycephalic (snub-nosed) dogs, cats and mixes are not permitted as cargo on any Delta or Delta Connection flight (Delta Cargo Restricted Animals + Shipping Your Pet).

breed_list.summary: Dogs (examples; Delta says list is not exhaustive): Affenpinscher; American Bully (all); American Pit Bull Terrier; American Staffordshire Terrier; Boston Terrier; Boxer (all); Bull Terrier (all); Brussels Griffin (Petite Brabançon); Bulldog (all); Chow Chow; English Toy Spaniel; Japanese Chin; King Charles Spaniel (Cavalier King); Lhasa Apso; Mastiff (all; Great Dane/German Mastiff excluded); Pekingese; Pit Bull; Pug (all); Shar Pei; Shih Tzu; Staffordshire Bull Terrier; Tibetan Spaniel. Cats: British Shorthair; Burmese; Exotic Shorthair; Himalayan; Persian; Scottish Fold. Hybrids of these breeds refused at all times.

airlines.conditions: Cargo weather: not shipped if ground temp >80°F (27°C) or <20°F (−7°C); acclimation certificate 20–45°F. Cabin destination exceptions on Overview. Soft kennel recommended max 18×11×11 in.
airlines.fetch_note: Cabin: no breed ban on Overview. Hold/cargo: refused with named example list from Delta Cargo Restricted Animals.

airlines.label: Official rule

cabin.summary: Same Alaska/Hawaiian program: short-nosed dogs and cats may travel in the cabin if the carrier fits under the seat (Alaska Air Cargo Pet Connect restrictions).

hold_cargo.summary: Alaska Air Cargo notice (Oct 1, 2026): brachycephalic dog and cat breeds no longer accepted in the cargo hold of Alaska Airlines, Hawaiian Airlines and Horizon Air aircraft. Hawaiian/Alaska passenger pets page: baggage-compartment pets subject to breed restrictions.

breed_list.summary: Same named list as Alaska Air Cargo Pet Connect restrictions (dogs and cats listed above under Alaska). Applies to Hawaiian Airlines aircraft for cargo hold.

airlines.conditions: Shared Alaska/Hawaiian pet program. Baggage: breed restrictions, travel-date embargoes, fleet restrictions. Cargo weather limits as on Alaska Air Cargo restrictions page. Cabin via chat/phone after booking.

airlines.label: Official rule

cabin.summary: Only small dogs and cats in an under-seat carrier. No snub-nosed / brachycephalic breed restriction stated.

hold_cargo.summary: No large dogs accommodated; pets travel in the cabin only. JetBlue does not accept pets as cargo (and does not accept pet remains in cabin or cargo).

breed_list.summary: Not stated on the official page

airlines.conditions: Max carrier 17×12.5×8.5 in. Max two pets per traveler (second seat + fee). Pet must remain in zipped carrier.

airlines.label: Official rule

cabin.summary: Cabin allowed for snub-nosed (단두종) animals, including mixes with non-snub-nosed breeds, only when cabin conditions are met (기내 반입 조건 충족하는 경우에만 기내 운송 가능).

hold_cargo.summary: Hold/checked baggage refused: animals at risk of breathing difficulty or death during air travel that are snub-nosed breeds, including mixes with non-snub-nosed breeds, cannot travel as checked baggage in the cargo hold (화물칸으로 위탁 운송 불가).

breed_list.summary: Dogs: Newfoundland; Dogo Argentino; Dogue de Bordeaux; Lhasa Apso; Boston Terrier; Boxer; Bulldog; Brussels Griffon; Shar-Pei; English Toy Spaniel; Shih Tzu; American Bully; Affenpinscher; Chihuahua; Japanese Chin; Chow Chow; Cane Corso; King Charles Spaniel; Cavalier King Charles Spaniel; Pug; Pekingese; Tibetan Spaniel. Cats: Burmese; British Shorthair; Scottish Fold; Exotic; Persian; Himalayan. Mixes of snub-nosed with non-snub-nosed breeds included.

airlines.conditions: Source is the Korean passenger guide page, section '운송제한 반려동물'. Exact rule: snub-nosed animals (incl. mixes) cannot go as checked baggage in the hold; cabin only if cabin conditions are met. Old English URL https://www.koreanair.com/contents/plan-your-travel/special-help/traveling-with-pets returns page-not-found / blocked. Cargo pages still refuse brachy as cargo (effective 1 Oct 2020).

airlines.label: Official rule

cabin.summary: Snub-nosed breeds may travel in the passenger cabin if they meet cabin rules (max 8 kg including container). Barred from the cargo hold since 1 January 2020.

hold_cargo.summary: Snub-nosed dog and cat breeds barred from the cargo hold since 1 January 2020. May be shipped as air freight via Lufthansa Cargo (separate process).

breed_list.summary: Dogs include: Affenpinscher; American Bully; Bulldogs (all except American bulldogs); Pugs (all); American pit bull terrier; American Staffordshire terrier; Boston terrier; Boxer; Brussels Griffon; Bull mastiff; Bull terrier (Miniature Bull Terrier excluded); Chow chow; English toy spaniel; Japanese chin; Japanese spaniel; King Charles Spaniel; Lhasa apso; Pekinese; Pit bulls; Shar Pei; Shih Tzu; Staffordshire bull terrier; Tibetan Spaniel (+ cross-breeds). Cats: British short-haired; Exotic shorthair; Himalayan; Persian; Scottish fold (+ cross-breeds).

airlines.conditions: Cabin: max 8 kg pet+container; container under the seat; signed cabin-animal form at check-in. Fighting/dangerous breeds have separate reinforced-crate rules for the hold (see same Lufthansa page). Snub-nosed barred from cargo hold since 1 January 2020; air freight via Lufthansa Cargo may still be possible.
